title: 🎉 Three Papers Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
excerpt: Three papers from our lab have been accepted at NeurIPS 2026, covering vision-language-action models, efficient LLM reasoning, and structural connectivity in vision encoders. Congratulations to all authors!
